_comment: Every rate the calculator uses, each with its own source and verification date.
PROVENANCE: figures come from the operator-supplied Master Build Brief dated
2026-08-28, which cites HighLevel's own help-centre articles. gohighlevel.com and
help.gohighlevel.com are both unreachable from this build environment, so nothing
here was read off the vendor page directly by the build.
PUBLISH RULE: re-check every figure against the live source on the day of first
publish and update verifiedOn. Wrong pricing is the fastest way to lose trust in
this niche, and trust is the entire product.

plans.name: Starter
plans.bestFor: One business, or an agency with up to three clients testing the platform.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.bestFor: Agencies past three clients who want white-label and rebilling at cost.

plans.name: Agency Pro
plans.aliasNote: HighLevel also markets this as "SaaS Pro" on its own upgrade funnel. It is the SAME $497 plan, not a separate fourth tier. Competitor pages listing them as two products at two prices are factually wrong.
plans.bestFor: Agencies reselling the platform as their own software with a margin on usage.

usage.smsNote: Per SMS segment, US/CA, inbound or outbound. A message over 160 GSM characters splits into multiple segments and is billed for each. Adding an emoji switches the encoding and drops the limit to 70 characters, which can quietly triple a campaign's cost.
usage.voiceNote: Outbound US voice per minute. Inbound via web/mobile/deskphone is lower; inbound via US call-forwarding is higher at $0.02/min.
usage.emailNote: LC Email, rebilled Mailgun. There is NO free tier — every email counts, including To, CC, BCC, inbound and outbound.
usage.premiumWorkflowNote: Premium workflow actions (Decision Maker, Intent Detection, Summarize Text, Translate) bill $0.01 per execution. At volume this is a real line item that no competitor's pricing page models.

models.name: Pay-per-use
models.note: Conversation AI billed on underlying model tokens. Voice AI = voice engine $0.045/min + TTS $0.015-$0.170/min + LLM tokens on top.
models.estimateBasis: Modelled from cited token rates (~$1.25/1M input, ~$10.00/1M output) at a typical short support exchange. This is an ESTIMATE, not a published per-message price — HighLevel bills tokens, not messages.

models.name: AI Employee Growth
models.note: 1,000 Conversation AI responses and 100 Voice AI minutes per location. Unlimited Reviews AI and Content AI. Bounded Funnel/Workflow/Email/Ask AI.

models.name: AI Employee Unlimited
models.note: Unlimited Conversation AI, Voice AI, Reviews AI and Content AI. 3x Ask AI/AI Studio allowance.
models.commissionNote: The only AI tier that earns NodeRow a commission.

ai.fairUseWarning: Both subscription AI tiers carry a fair-use clause. "Unlimited" is throttleable under the terms of service.
ai.twoMeterWarning: Voice AI minutes do NOT include the phone call itself. LC Phone per-minute charges apply on top, even on AI Employee Unlimited. Two separate meters. This is the single most commonly misunderstood cost on the platform.

rebilling.marginTrapWarning: HighLevel bills your agency on ACTUAL consumption regardless of what you charge the sub-account. Set a flat rate below real usage cost and you absorb the loss on every unit.
rebilling.marginTrapQuote: Your agency continues to be charged by HighLevel based on actual token consumption for AI products, regardless of the pricing model configured for sub-accounts.

addOns.name: White-label mobile app
addOns.note: 4-12 week App Store approval commonly reported. A separate one-time submission fee is claimed by third parties but UNVERIFIED.

unverified: Extended 30/60-day trial length via affiliate links — no first-party source. Do NOT claim a specific extended trial length.
